answer: A stranger cannot walk in and claim a trade he never learned, because the trade keeps its own memory. Cutler blade ledger with cutlers attestation is that memory, written down and witnessed: ten-year ledger, 5,000 blades ground, steel accounts, annual inspection. Claim a trade on a counterfeit delta and the claim is thrown out, the claimant pays the examination fee threefold and the onyx is forfeited to the guild, while the jetty is recorded and produced whenever the claim is repeated.
